page.layout: One printed page holding an index in two parallel columns separated by a vertical rule: the left column (Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Esaias) and the right column (Lamentations-free continuation: Jeremias, Ezechiel, Daniel, Haggai, Zacharias, Malachias). Heading INDEX centred at the top spanning both columns. A small "Cap." catchword-like marker at the lower right of the right column is part of the table header for the final page of the list. No running head, no page number printed.
page.notes: Printed in two columns with blue underlined references (hyperlinked-looking numbers) and black numbers; the bare column-heading "Cap." at the foot is a continuation marker. Several Roman numerals in the left column are of uncertain form (e.g. "XIV", "XLIX", "LIII") and the page numbers in the Psalm and Jeremiah entries are partly blurred. Headings for each book are set in spaced capitals and were given level 2 as sub-parts of the index. Page numbers and cross-references are mostly in blue print but were copied as plain numbers. The line "Cap." at bottom right and the small marks at the page edges are not treated as text.
